dedupe_keys.name: tracss dataset for conjunction assessment verification us office of space commerce

description: This test dataset was developed for the Traffic Coordination System for Space (TraCSS) to help space situational awareness service providers test their conjunction assessment algorithms. It comes with an answer key listing the conjunctions in the dataset, as a voluntary self-assessment tool. The release has five files: the Aerospace IV&V dataset archive dated 9 October 2025 (20.73 GB), two answer keys for the spherical and the SFSH screening volume configurations (198.8 MB and 62.4 MB compressed CSV), and a mapping of object sizes to screening volumes, with the configuration of each test case described in a user's guide. Access is free through a Google Form, and the files are hosted on Google Drive. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC0-1.0. Coverage is the orbital population in the test scenario. It supports benchmarking of collision screening, a core function of space traffic management that protects satellite infrastructure; related records are the Space-Track satellite catalogue and the EU SST services. The underlying files were not downloaded, so their contents are not verified here.
